payload.description_html: Line drawing of MNA V10666 (Crosbysaurus sp.). Interpretive line drawing of MNA V10666, Crosbysaurus sp., from MNA Locality 1725 showing the outline of the tooth if complete and the surface anatomy of the preserved crown. (A) presumed labial (B) presumed lingual views. Abbreviations: Ap, apex; DD, distal denticles; MD, mesial denticles; RP, resorption pit. Scale = 1 mm.
